tools.name: boltzpay_fetch
tools.description: Fetch data from a paid API endpoint. Automatically detects the payment protocol (x402 or L402), pays the required amount, and returns a structured JSON response with status, ok, body, and optional payment metadata.

url.description: The URL of the paid API endpoint

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers as key-value pairs

tools.name: boltzpay_quote
tools.description: Check if an API endpoint requires payment and how much it costs, without actually paying. Returns the detected protocol, amount, and currency. Use this before boltzpay_fetch to preview costs.

url.description: The URL to check for pricing

tools.name: boltzpay_budget
tools.description: View your current spending budget status including limits, amount spent, and remaining balance. Use this to check how much you can still spend.

tools.name: boltzpay_history
tools.description: List recent payments made during this session, including URLs, amounts, protocols, chains, and timestamps. Use this to review what has been paid for.

tools.name: boltzpay_discover
tools.description: Browse a directory of known compatible paid API endpoints with live status checks. Each endpoint is probed in real-time to verify availability and current pricing. Filter by category to find relevant data sources. Categories: crypto-data, social, finance, research, dev-tools, ai-tools, utilities, demo, media.

category.description: Filter by category (e.g. crypto-data, social, finance, research, dev-tools, ai-tools, utilities, demo, media)

enableLiveDiscovery.description: Fetch live endpoints from Bazaar Discovery API (default: true)

tools.name: boltzpay_wallet
tools.description: Check wallet connectivity, credentials, balances, and budget. Tests the CDP connection when credentials are configured.

tools.name: boltzpay_diagnose
tools.description: Full diagnostic of a URL: DNS, protocol detection (x402/L402), format version, pricing, health, and latency. Returns a complete report in one call — no payment credentials required.
